name: Dani Moonstar

abilityDetails.Falter: Rakibin bir sonraki saldırısının ıskalamasına sebep olur.
abilityDetails.Neuroshock: Rakibe zamanla yüksek elektrik tabanlı hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Marked: Regeneration, Immortality, Indestructible ve Death Immunity etkilerinin yetenek doğruluğunu %100 azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Onu E1'de tut (kaçmak daha kolay). Bloğuna vurmaktan kaçın, çünkü görünmez olabiliyor.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Barbed Arrows
If a Neuroshock or Stun Debuff is removed for any reason other than expiry, [20 - 100]% chance to inflict a Neuroshock Passive dealing [7,008] Energy Damage over 8 seconds. This is not affected by Ability Accuracy Reduction.
When the Opponent's Health is at or below 10%, inflict an indefinite Marked Passive.

abilitySections.title: Illusion
content: When either Champion's Combo Meter passes a multiple of 10, gain a non-stacking indefinite Illusion. An Illusion is lost when Knocked Down.
Gain an Illusion when inflicted with Disorient, Fragility, or Intimidate. Dani will attempt to regain Illusion every 10 seconds if Illusion is consumed while suffering from these effects.

When Dani would Block a Basic Attack, she consumes an Illusion to inflict a 150% Falter Passive. This Falter lasts 2.5 seconds, is not affected by Ability Accuracy Reduction, and is paused during Dani's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Neural Arrows - Max Stacks: 5
content: When the Opponent Misses, gain an indefinite Neural Arrow. As a Defender, hitting the Opponent's Block while Dani has an Illusion also grants a Neural Arrow.

For each Neural Arrow, the final hit of Dani's Special Attacks inflicts a Neuroshock Debuff dealing [7,008] Energy Damage over 8 seconds. All Neural Arrows are removed at the end of Dani's Special Attacks.
Against Skill Champions, Neuroshocks are inflicted on Special activation. Skill Champions cannot heal while suffering from Neuroshock.

abilitySections.title: Prowess Effects - Max Stacks: 5
content: Unless otherwise stated, Dani's Prowess effects are indefinite and have 15% potency. If her Prowess effects fail to trigger or are removed by the Opponent, gain a Neural Arrow.
Gain a Prowess Buff when Faltering the Opponent, and one more each time Dani strikes a Faltered Opponent. As a Defender, striking the Opponent while Dani has an Illusion also grants a Prowess Buff.
Activating a Special Attack with Neural Arrows removes all personal Prowess Buffs and replaces them with Prowess Passives. All personal Prowess effects are removed at the end of the Special Attack.
All personal Prowess Passives gained during Special Attacks gain 80% potency for each Neural Arrow.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On the first hit, inflict a Slow Passive for 24 seconds.
Just before the final hit, gain an Unblockable Passive lasting 1 second for each Neural Arrow.
The final hit inflicts a non-stacking [2,750] Energy Vulnerability Passive for 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit grants a 10% Impact Passive for 5 seconds. This can trigger through Block.
Activating this Special Attack with 5 or more Neural Arrows inflicts a 70% Overload Passive for 25 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This Special Attack costs 6% less power, and costs an additional 6% less for each Neural Arrow.
After this attack, gain 6 Prowess Buffs. The limit for personal Prowess Buffs is increased to 10 until the end of the next Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Barbed Arrows
content: If a Neuroshock or Stun Debuff is removed for any reason other than expiry, [20 - 100]% chance to inflict a Neuroshock Passive dealing [7,008] Energy Damage over 8 seconds. This is not affected by Ability Accuracy Reduction.
When the Opponent's Health is at or below 10%, inflict an indefinite Marked Passive.
